description: This file defines the 'OrderedByteChunker' class, responsible for handling chunked byte data, particularly for ordered processing of byte streams, with callbacks for each chunk processed.

classes.name: OrderedByteChunker
classes.description: A class that manages ordered chunking and processing of byte streams, providing methods for adding bytes, and internally popping and processing chunks with progress tracking.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the chunker with specified chunk sizes, source information, and callback function.

methods.name: addBytes
methods.description: Adds new bytes to the buffer and processes chunks if the buffer is sufficiently filled.

methods.name: popBytes
methods.description: Processes and dispatches a chunk of bytes, updating progress and invoking the onChunk callback.
